item.title: Wisconsin receives failing grades in tobacco control
item.description: Tobacco use is Wisconsin's and the country’s leading cause of preventable death and disease. The post Wisconsin receives failing grades in tobacco control appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Ag leaders: Trade could make or break Wisconsin farms in 2026
item.description: Leaders in Wisconsin agriculture are warning the state's farmers to brace for another tough year for trade and market conditions. The post Ag leaders: Trade could make or break Wisconsin farms in 2026 appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Plans move forward to bring new nuclear energy to Kewaunee County
item.description: EnergySolutions first announced plans to explore bringing new nuclear power to the Kewaunee County site last year. The post Plans move forward to bring new nuclear energy to Kewaunee County appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Supreme Court candidates differ on state courts’ role in federal immigration disputes
item.description: Wisconsin's Supreme Court candidates have different opinions about the role state courts should in disputes involving federal immigration agents. The post Supreme Court candidates differ on state courts’ role in federal immigration disputes appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Becoming an organ donor: Difficult decision leads to tremendous gift
item.description: “The operation takes two to three hours,” Dr. Nikole Neidlinger said on "The Larry Meiller Show." “When we attach a kidney and open it up to blood flow, it just starts functioning. I've seen it thousands of times now, but every time I'm like, ‘This is a miracle. This is amazing.’” The post Becoming an organ donor: Difficult decision leads to tremendous gift appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Milwaukee County benefits director fired following lapse in health insurance contract
item.description: Milwaukee County Executive David Crowley announced an "employee" who let the county's health insurance contract with UnitedHealthcare lapse last year has been fired. The post Milwaukee County benefits director fired following lapse in health insurance contract appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin’s version of C-SPAN resumes coverage at the state Capitol
item.description: Wisconsin’s version of C-SPAN is back online after going dark for about seven weeks due to a lack of funding. The post Wisconsin’s version of C-SPAN resumes coverage at the state Capitol appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Measles confirmed in UW-Madison student
item.description: Officials shared several locations where the public was exposed Monday through Wednesday last week, including UW-Madison's Union South, the Waisman Center and a Qdoba location near campus. The post Measles confirmed in UW-Madison student appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin Democrats announce marijuana legalization bill
item.description: In a bid to capitalize on recent bipartisan pushes to regulate the state's hemp industry, Wisconsin Democrats have introduced a bill to fully legalize marijuana. But the plan is doomed in the Republican-led Legislature. The post Wisconsin Democrats announce marijuana legalization bill appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Democratic challenger Rebecca Cooke outraises US Rep. Derrick Van Orden
item.description: Eau Claire Democrat Rebecca Cooke has outraised Republican Congressman Derrick Van Orden for the first time in Wisconsin's hotly contested 3rd Congressional District race. The post Democratic challenger Rebecca Cooke outraises US Rep. Derrick Van Orden appeared first on WPR.
